interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under this renewal system are valid for twenty-four (24) months and shall expire on the last day of the last month of the license period.

required.quote: Any person licensed to practice medicine in this state shall complete continuing medical education as required by the board of medical examiners.

available.quote: The board is authorized to accept the certificates of licensure from other states as long as the applicant's certificates and qualifications meet or exceed the requirements set forth in § 63-6-207 and the rules promulgated pursuant thereto.

requirements.value: Applicant's certificates and qualifications must meet or exceed the requirements of § 63-6-207. Board must render a decision within 45 days of receiving a completed application from an out-of-state licensee.

title_protection.quote: Includes attaching any of the following words or abbreviations to a name, either alone or in connection with other words or abbreviations indicating or inducing others to believe that the person is engaged in the practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine, including: "Doctor of medicine"; "M.D."; ... "Physician"

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional, dishonorable or unethical conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional, dishonorable or unethical conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or attempted violation of any provision of this chapter or any lawful board order or any criminal statute of this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or attempted violation, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter or, any lawful order of the board issued pursuant thereto or any criminal statute of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false statements, fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false statements or representations, being guilty of fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or being guilty of fraud or deceit in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of drugs or liquors in a manner adversely affecting ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs or the use of intoxicating liquors, narcotics, controlled substances, controlled substance analogues or other drugs or stimulants in such manner as to adversely affect the person's ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the laws governing abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the laws governing abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully betraying a professional secret
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully betraying a professional secret

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising medical business using untrue or misleading statements or fraudulent advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The advertising of medical business in which untrue or misleading statements are made or causing the publication or circulation of fraudulent advertising relative to any disease, human ailment or conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of board rules regulating advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of the rules and regulations promulgated by the board of medical examiners to regulate advertising by practitioners who are under the jurisdiction of such board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, drug offense, offense involving moral turpitude, or sex offense requiring registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, conviction of any offense under state or federal laws relative to drugs or the practice of medicine, conviction of any offense involving moral turpitude or conviction of any offense for which the person is required to register as a sexual offender or violent sexual offender pursuant to title 40, chapter 39, part 2

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or signing in one's professional capacity a certificate known to be false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or signing in one's professional capacity any certificate that is known to be false at the time one makes or signs such certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or distributing controlled substances or drugs not in course of professional practice or not medically necessary
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance or any other drug not in the course of professional practice, or not in good faith to relieve pain and suffering, or not to cure an ailment, physical infirmity or disease, or in amounts and/or for durations not medically necessary, advisable or justified for a diagnosed condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing controlled substances to an addicted person without bona fide effort to cure the addiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing to any person a controlled substance or other drug if such person is addicted to the habit of using controlled substances without making a bona fide effort to cure the habit of such patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or distributing controlled substances in violation of state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance, controlled substance analogue or other drug to any person in violation of any law of the state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to cure or treat disease by secret means, method, device or instrumentality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking or agreeing to cure or treat a disease, injury, ailment or infirmity by a secret means, method, device or instrumentality

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving, or aiding the giving or receiving of rebates
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving or receiving, or aiding or abetting the giving or receiving, of rebates, either directly or indirectly

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of medicine under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner, or a like, similar or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of medicine when mentally or physically unable to safely do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of medicine when mentally or physically unable to safely do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using radiation to treat noncancerous skin conditions without adequately warning the patient of cancer risk
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using radiation in the treatment of any noncancerous disease, disorder or condition of the skin without first adequately warning the patient of the extent of any known risk of cancer associated with such treatment or repetition of such treatment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action in another state for acts that would constitute grounds for discipline in Tennessee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against a person licensed to practice medicine by another state or territory of the United States for any acts or omissions that would constitute grounds for discipline of a person licensed in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transferring patient medical information (X-rays/imaging) to an unlicensed out-of-state person for diagnosis/treatment of Tennessee patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Transferring of patient medical information to a person in another state who is not licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the state of Tennessee using any electronic, telephonic or fiber optic means or by any other method if such information is employed to diagnose and/or treat persons physically located within the state of Tennessee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting with a laboratory for pathology/cytology services and billing patient without required disclosure of lab name and amounts paid
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No person licensed in this state to practice medicine shall agree or contract with any clinical, bioanalytical or hospital laboratory, wherever located, to pay such laboratory for anatomic pathology services or cytology services and thereafter include such costs in the bill or statement submitted to the patient or any entity or person for payment, unless the practitioner is in compliance with the requirements of § 56-7-1015(g) and discloses on the bill or statement

definition_quote.value: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine within the meaning of this chapter who treats, or professes to diagnose, treat, operates on or prescribes for any physical ailment or any physical injury to or deformity of another.
definition_quote.quote: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine within the meaning of this chapter who treats, or professes to diagnose, treat, operates on or prescribes for any physical ailment or any physical injury to or deformity of another.

methods_authorized.quote: Any person shall be regarded as practicing medicine within the meaning of this chapter who treats, or professes to diagnose, treat, operates on or prescribes for any physical ailment or any physical injury to or deformity of another.

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe drugs; may issue handwritten, typed, or computer-generated prescription orders.
drug_authority.quote: Any handwritten prescription order for a drug prepared by a physician or surgeon who is authorized by law to prescribe a drug must be legible so that it is comprehensible by the pharmacist who fills the prescription.

license_status_types.quote: The board also has the authority to issue locum tenens and/or conditional licenses as it deems appropriate after reviewing the qualifications of applicants. In addition to the authority granted the board in § 63-6-214, the board has the authority to issue restricted licenses and special licenses based upon licensure to another state for the limited purpose of authorizing the practice of telemedicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical school graduates must provide: a certificate from a medical school with curriculum acceptable to the board; a permanent ECFMG certificate; evidence of US citizenship or legal work authorization; evidence of completing a three-year post-graduate training program approved by the AMA; and sufficient evidence of good moral character.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A copy of a permanent Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) certificate; ... Evidence of satisfactory completion of a three-year post-graduate training program approved by the American Medical Association or its extant accreditation program for medical education, or its successor.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Evidence of the satisfactory completion of: A one-year United States training program approved by the American Medical Association or its extant accreditation program for medical education, or its successor

telemedicine_license_available.quote: the board has the authority to issue restricted licenses and special licenses based upon licensure to another state for the limited purpose of authorizing the practice of telemedicine to current applicants or current licensees, or both, as it deems necessary

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with all states legally joining therein

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: This chapter must not be construed to prohibit service rendered by a physician assistant practicing in collaboration with a physician, osteopathic physician, or podiatrist in accordance with the requirements of title 63, chapter 19, whether through protocols or a collaborative agreement.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: In consultation with the office of general counsel and in accordance with board guidelines, decide whether a licensee who is the subject of a complaint or an investigation is an appropriate candidate for diversion to a professional peer review organization or impaired professional association

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing this section, the board shall, upon probable cause, have authority to compel an applicant or licensee to submit to a mental and/or physical examination by a designated committee of at least three (3) practicing physicians, including a psychiatrist where a question of mental condition is involved.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board is authorized in its discretion to issue limited licenses to physicians who have been out of clinical practice for an extended period of time or who have been, or are at the time of their application, engaged exclusively in administrative medicine.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board also has the authority to issue locum tenens and/or conditional licenses as it deems appropriate after reviewing the qualifications of applicants.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A licensing board or disciplinary subcommittee shall not revoke, fail to renew, suspend, or take any action against a healthcare provider's license issued under this title, based solely on the healthcare provider's recommendations to an eligible patient regarding access to or treatment with an investigational drug, biological product, or device.
